shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: Chaupai.
Where there is a heavy congregation of Singhs;
Where thousands of Rehitvant Singhs have gathered.
Where an army of Singhs roam;
Where all the Singhs are Rehitvant.
One should remain there for five years;
And serve the Singhs in the best of ways.
One should be firm of mind and engage in devotion;
One shall obtain the complete Rehit there;
When all of the creation was first born;
Then the manukh's body was made.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਇਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਕੇਸ ਜੁ ਦੀਨੋ॥
verses.translit_en: tan is ke sir kes ju dheeno||

en.bdb: Upon the head this body hair was given;
Which was an adornment on his body.
The beard, mustache, and hair upon the head was fashioned upon him;

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਇਹ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਜ਼ਾਈ॥੯੦॥
verses.translit_en: hai ieh dhiraRh jeh prabhoo razaiee||90||

en.bdb: This was firmly will of God.
One who erases this will by shaving his head;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ॥੯੧॥
verses.translit_en: kahu te jag kaise har paavai||91||

en.bdb: Tell me, how will he find God in this world?
Like a bird without its wings,
Like a sheep without it's wool;
Like a woman without her clothes;
Such is a man without his Kes.
When man retains his Kes;
Only then he is in his complete and perfect form.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਸ ਏਕ ਪੁਨ ਰਹਤ ਜੁ ਪਾਈ॥
verses.translit_en: kes ek pun rahat ju paiee||

en.bdb: The Kes is one virtuous Rehit to have.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ॥੯੫॥
verses.translit_en: taa(n) kee mahimaa kahee na jaiee||95||

en.bdb: It's entire glory cannot be described.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਰਹਤ ਜਿਮ ਦਿਜ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵਤ॥
verses.translit_en: bedh rahat jim dhij na suhaavat||

en.bdb: As Without the Vedas the dij (twice-born) is not exalted;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਲ ਰਹਤ ਕੁਲ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਤ॥੯੬॥
verses.translit_en: seel rahat kul naar na bhaavat||96||

en.bdb: As without gentleness a woman is disliked by her children;
As without swiftness a horse is useless;
In the same way, the Kes are defiled without the Rehit.
As It is futile to wash a donkey;
Or to embellish it's forehead with a garland of flowers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਕਰ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਹੀ॥
verses.translit_en: teh kar taa(n) kee sobhaa naahee||

en.bdb: There is no glory in these actions;
It is only worthy of mockery in this world.
Thus is the state of one who disregards Rehit whilst keeping Kes;
Tell me, how does he gain glory?

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਸੁ ਕੇਸਨ ਕੋ ਅਤਿ ਭੂਖਨ॥
verses.translit_en: rahat su kesan ko at bhookhan||

en.bdb: The Rehit is the greatest embellishment for the Kes;

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਿਰ ਕੇਸ ਭੀ ਦੂਖਨ॥੧੦੧॥
verses.translit_en: rahat binaa sir kes bhee dhookhan||101||

en.bdb: Without the Rehit, the Kes are also pained.
If there is a Rehitvan (one who is fully observant of the Rehit) Singh in this world;
The Guru's people will follow his example.
May my Sikh remain forever obedient to the Rehit;

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਚੇਰਾ॥੧੦੩॥
verses.translit_en: veh Thaakur mai(n) us kaa cheraa||103||

en.bdb: He is my master and I am his disciple.
If one lives according to the Rehit  that disease (separation from God) shall diminish.
The Rehit is the support of the Singh's Dharam.
Without Rehit, there is no eternal liberation;

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਭਲ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ॥੧੦੫॥
verses.translit_en: rahat binaa bhal kahai na koiee||105||

en.bdb: Without Rehit, one is never considered virtuous.
Without the Rehit, do not call oneself a Singh.
Without the Rehit, one suffers punishment at the court of the Lord.
Without the Rehit, one will wander lost in this world.
Without the Rehit, man sends descends into hell.
Without the Rehit, one is a Tankhahiya.
Without the Rehit, consider one to be a thorough ghost.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਲਹੈ॥
verses.translit_en: rahat binaa sukh kabahoo na lahai||

en.bdb: Without the Rehit, one will never attain bliss and content.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹ ਕਰ ਗਹੈ॥੧੦੯॥
verses.translit_en: taa(n) te rahat su dhiraRh kar gahai||109||

en.bdb: Therefore, hold fast to the Rehit.
